rig: shared humanoid rig (tools/blender/humanoid_rig.py): 40 joints, same bone names and rest ORIENTATIONS as the player; only bone lengths / offsets differ on troll and golem (brute_warp in tools/blender/mon_lib.py).
retargeting: replay the shared clips (assets/models/char/humanoid_anims.glb) by bone name: quaternion tracks as they are, hips position track multiplied by hipsRatio (= hipsHeight / 0.98). Verified offline with the real clips.
units: meters; rest pose = the rig T-pose; armature root at the origin on the ground, facing +Z in glTF (Blender -Y)

skeleton.restSpace: glTF / three.js axes (x = character left, y up, z = front), meters, armature at the origin
skeleton.description: skeleton warrior: rigid bones, rusted cap and pauldron, torn tabard

troll.restSpace: glTF / three.js axes (x = character left, y up, z = front), meters, armature at the origin
troll.description: mountain troll: warty hide, pot belly, tusks, ragged fur loincloth

golem.restSpace: glTF / three.js axes (x = character left, y up, z = front), meters, armature at the origin
golem.description: golem of cracked volcanic rock: rigid basalt plates on glowing ember cores
golem.glowMaterial: M_ember (cores, joints, eyes, chest heart): swap for M_ice for the frost variant

materialNotes.M_eye_glow: small emissive eye spheres (not in the convention table): unlit emissive, vertex color = tint (skeleton pale green, troll amber). Golem eyes are part of M_ember.
materialNotes.M_ember: golem cores / joints / eyes / chest heart: own primitive, swap for M_ice (frost variant) and tint M_rock.
materialNotes.M_cloth: skeleton tabard, belt and diagonal strap (dark vertex colors read as old leather). The tabard is modelled double-sided (two faces per quad), single-sided rendering is fine.
